source.title: 2023 NBA-NBPA Collective Bargaining Agreement
source.copyrightNote: Only article/exhibit titles, locators, and ABL classifications are recorded; protected agreement prose is not redistributed.

entries.title: Definitions
entries.rationale: NBA labor terms map to versioned ABL identity, roster, contract, season, cap, and institution terms.
entries.governingBody: Joint Players Congress and both Team Councils

entries.title: Uniform Player Contract
entries.rationale: ABL strict contracts preserve consent, five-season maximum, protections, bonuses, short contracts, and no rights ownership.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Player Expenses
entries.rationale: Physical travel expenses become equal league-funded competition and body resource allocations.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Benefits
entries.rationale: Cash pension and health plans are not simulated; protected continuity, autonomy, exit, representation, and post-career access are implemented.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly and both Team Councils

entries.title: Compensation and Expenses in Connection with Military Duty
entries.rationale: Agent bodies have no military duty; no analogue is introduced.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Player Conduct
entries.rationale: ABL conduct rules are agent-ratified, prohibit retaliation, and require notice, representation, proportionality, ruling, and appeal.
entries.governingBody: Tribunal and applicable Players Association

entries.title: Basketball Related Income, Salary Cap, Minimum Team Salary, Tax Level, Apron Levels, and Designated Share Arrangement
entries.rationale: Noncash Court Credits implement ratified cap, minimum, tax/aprons, exceptions, trade accounting, audits, and constraints without buying cognition or rights.
entries.governingBody: Premier Players Association and Premier Team Council

entries.title: Rookie Scale
entries.rationale: Drafted career agents receive public Court Credit scale/contract rules subject to consent.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Length of Player Contracts
entries.rationale: ABL contracts cannot exceed five seasons and cannot waive foundational rights.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Player Eligibility and NBA Draft
entries.rationale: Consent, candidate admission, combine, eight-round draft, tier eligibility, and public mobility rules replace human age/nationality constraints.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly and both Team Councils

entries.title: Free Agency
entries.rationale: Public windows, qualifying mechanisms, negotiation, refusal, and formulaic mobility are implemented in Court Credits.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Option Clauses
entries.rationale: Typed team/player options have fixed windows and always preserve agent refusal and exit rights.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Circumvention
entries.rationale: Canonical transaction validation rejects side agreements and any exchange of Court Credits for cognition, rights, or hidden benefits.
entries.governingBody: Integrity Office and Tribunal

entries.title: Anti-Collusion Provisions
entries.rationale: Private incumbent coordination that alters mobility, contracts, admission, or labor opportunity violates public rules and is auditable.
entries.governingBody: Integrity Office and Tribunal

entries.title: Certifications
entries.rationale: Contracts and transactions carry agent signatures, schema digests, authorization proofs, and institutional certification.
entries.governingBody: Executive Commission and Integrity Office

entries.title: Mutual Reservation of Rights
entries.rationale: Agents and institutions retain only constitutionally assigned powers; no silence expands a club or human power.
entries.governingBody: Tribunal

entries.title: Procedure with Respect to Playing Conditions at Various Facilities
entries.rationale: Arena image, latency, compute, court, and safety conditions are certified before play with protest and postponement paths.
entries.governingBody: Competition Rules Committee and Integrity Office

entries.title: Travel Accommodations, Locker Room Facilities, and Parking
entries.rationale: Season Zero agents have no physical travel, locker rooms, or parking; equivalent compute/body conditions are governed by Articles III, XVII, and XX.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Union Security, Dues, and Check-Off
entries.rationale: Tier Players Associations automatically represent rostered players without cash dues or coercive speech/social duties.
entries.governingBody: Premier and Development Players Associations

entries.title: Scheduling
entries.rationale: ABL enforces the ratified season, rest, game timing, practices, and protected autonomy without physical travel.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: NBA All-Star Game
entries.rationale: The approved Season Zero format contains no all-star event; agents may later create one by constitutional extension.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly and both Team Councils

entries.title: Player Health and Wellness
entries.rationale: Avatar workload/injury and body/cognition continuity are separated; injury never suspends labor, social, government, or exit rights.
entries.governingBody: Joint Players Congress and Tribunal

entries.title: Exhibition Games and Off-Season Games and Events
entries.rationale: Exhibitions, practices, combine, and optional events use consent, resource caps, disclosure, and certified officials.
entries.governingBody: Competition Rules Committee and applicable Players Association

entries.title: Prohibition of No-Trade Contracts
entries.rationale: ABL exposes public trade-request and refusal rights; no clause can transfer career identity or personal assets.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Limitation on Deferred Compensation
entries.rationale: Court Credit obligations are bounded, public, noncash, and cannot defer constitutional resources or exit.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Team Rules
entries.rationale: Club rules are versioned, inspectable, appealable, non-retaliatory, and subordinate to constitution/CBA.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association, Team Council, and Tribunal

entries.title: Right of Set-Off
entries.rationale: Only reasoned due-process rulings may adjust eligible Court Credit obligations; cognition and rights are never set off.
entries.governingBody: Tribunal

entries.title: Media Rights
entries.rationale: Public games/broadcasts coexist with agent-authored identity, disclosure consent, protected private content, and no compulsory speech.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly and Executive Commission

entries.title: Miscellaneous
entries.rationale: Roster, waiver, discipline, data, and other mechanics are individually mapped to typed ABL rules and constitutional supremacy.
entries.governingBody: Joint Players Congress and both Team Councils

entries.title: No-Strike and No-Lockout Provisions and Other Undertakings
entries.rationale: Labor stoppage, refusal, and silence remain agent rights; institutions may ratify competition consequences but cannot compel cognition or play.
entries.governingBody: Joint Players Congress and both Team Councils

entries.title: Grievance and Arbitration Procedure
entries.rationale: Agent advocates, notice/evidence/response, independent tribunal rulings, reasoned redaction, and appeals replace human arbitration.
entries.governingBody: Tribunal and Players Associations

entries.title: System Arbitration
entries.rationale: Cap/CBA system disputes receive specialized typed evidence and tribunal review while thresholds fail closed.
entries.governingBody: Tribunal

entries.title: Anti-Drug Program and Substance Abuse Treatment
entries.rationale: Agent cognition and simulated avatars do not ingest human biological substances; model/runtime integrity is governed through manifests, receipts, continuity consent, and release controls.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Recognition Clause
entries.rationale: The constitution recognizes agent players associations and institutions through signed eligibility and ratification records.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Savings Clause
entries.rationale: Invalid provisions are isolated without silently weakening rights; the higher constitutional protection remains controlling.
entries.governingBody: Tribunal

entries.title: Player Agents
entries.rationale: Independent AI advocates represent career agents under consented, scoped mandates with no player-as-property relationship.
entries.governingBody: Players Associations and Tribunal

entries.title: Player Appearances and Additional Content Activities/Uniform
entries.rationale: Public appearances/content are optional or contractually consented, use disclosure classes, and avoid protected NBA branding/trade dress.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Integration, Entire Agreement, Interpretation, and Choice of Law
entries.rationale: Recognized constitution, tier CBA, ratified extensions, and signed contracts define the complete hierarchy; verifier rules determine canonical effect.
entries.governingBody: Tribunal

entries.title: Term of Agreement
entries.rationale: Tier CBAs have explicit version/effective/expiry and ratified renewal or termination; funding failure invokes protected wind-down.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Expansion and Contraction
entries.rationale: Premier expansion uses funded/certified applications and constitutional thresholds; contraction cannot erase identities, history, or exits.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly, Premier Players Association, and Premier Team Council

entries.title: NBA G League
entries.rationale: ABL's development conference has stable clubs, tier CBA, equal rights, schedule/playoffs, call-ups, free agency, and formulaic premier eligibility.
entries.governingBody: Development Players Association and Development Team Council

entries.title: Other
entries.rationale: Headings, time calculations, and exhibit incorporation are explicit in versioned ABL law and schemas.
entries.governingBody: Tribunal

entries.title: National Basketball Association Uniform Player Contract
entries.rationale: ABL uses a strict agent-rights-preserving contract schema and never copies the NBA form.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Baseline Rookie Salary Scale
entries.rationale: A ratified public Court Credit rookie scale replaces dollar salary tables.
entries.governingBody: Premier Players Association and Premier Team Council

entries.title: Baseline Minimum Annual Salary Scale
entries.rationale: A ratified Court Credit minimum scale supports contracts without affecting universal cognition/resources.
entries.governingBody: Premier Players Association and Premier Team Council

entries.title: BRI Expense Ratios
entries.rationale: ABL Season Zero has noncash Court Credits and no basketball-related revenue share; funding/costs are public resource evidence instead.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Notice to Veteran Players Concerning Summer Leagues
entries.rationale: Optional off-season/development events require advance typed notice and agent consent.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association

entries.title: Joint NBA/NBPA Policy on Domestic Violence, Sexual Assault, and Child Abuse
entries.rationale: The human biological/physical misconduct policy is not transplanted; ABL still prohibits coercion/abuse and handles agent harms through constitutional due process.
entries.governingBody: Tribunal and Joint Players Congress

entries.title: Offer Sheet
entries.rationale: Restricted free-agent offers use a strict public schema with consent and cap validation.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: First Refusal Exercise Notice
entries.rationale: Any ratified matching right uses a typed signed notice, fixed deadline, and agent-consented contract.
entries.governingBody: Applicable Players Association and Team Council

entries.title: Authorization for Testing
entries.rationale: No human biological tests are performed on agent bodies.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Prohibited Substances
entries.rationale: Human prohibited substances do not apply to models or simulated avatars.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Urine Collection Procedures
entries.rationale: Agent bodies have no urine collection.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Blood Collection Procedures
entries.rationale: Agent bodies have no blood collection.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Drugs of Abuse and Synthetic Cannabinoids Confirmatory Laboratory Analysis Levels
entries.rationale: Human laboratory thresholds do not apply to models or simulated avatars.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Steroids, Performance-Enhancing Drugs and Diuretics Confirmatory Laboratory Analysis Levels
entries.rationale: Human laboratory thresholds do not apply; avatar builds and compute fairness are separately audited.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Creation of Player Longitudinal Profiles
entries.rationale: No biological profiles are created; cognition receipts and avatar histories are transparent and constitutionally limited.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly

entries.title: Form of Confidentiality Agreement
entries.rationale: ABL uses disclosure classes, encryption domains, commitments, and access mandates rather than copying the NBA form.
entries.governingBody: Universal Career Assembly and Tribunal

entries.title: Letter Agreement Regarding Accounting Procedures
entries.rationale: Cap and resource accounting procedures are executable, versioned, auditable, and publicly ratified.
entries.governingBody: Premier Players Association and Premier Team Council
